question:
I have a dbt_project file that looks like this

name: "project"
version: 1.0.0
config-version: 2

profile: default

vars:
  model:
    enabled: "{{ target.name == 'test' | as_bool }}"

But it keeps complaining -

Parsing Error
  at path ['enabled']: 'False' is not of type 'boolean'

Any pointer would be appreciated.

I used this - https://docs.getdbt.com/reference/dbt-jinja-functions/as_bool - as reference. I also tried converting to lower before bool but that didnt work either.

I have tried the following variations

    enabled: "{{ (target.name == 'test') | as_bool }}" -- gives the same error 
    enabled: {{ (target.name == 'test') | as_bool }} -- gives compilation error
title: dbt_project as_bool not working as expected
answer:
Try removing quotes, you need to get False, not "False".

I've tested it a little to make sure it compiles and works this time.

What you need are parenthesis for the condition, so your code should be:

enabled: "{{ (target.name == 'test') | as_bool }}"

instead of

enabled: "{{ target.name == 'test' | as_bool }}"
